the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: Reduce to a base change by an envelope by verifying the desired commutativity on the surjective pushforward image using the Gysin base change lemma twice and the push-pull formula for the cap action twice, then use locality of the operators on opens to work affinely, use the proper cover lemma to put the relative cycle into the image of the cycle-classes construction and reduce by linearity to a single cycle class of a flat closed subscheme against a single prime cycle, dispose of the case where the prime cycle lies inside the divisor where both sides vanish, and in the remaining case evaluate both sides explicitly with the flat closed-pair cap formula giving the same class on the fibred products (source lines 2636-2715)
